scope: Outside PDS: CSA, INPTDAT, open scientific repositories, linked chemical evidence
protocol: Existing schema 3 permits separate Fe/Mg blank controls; this search does not amend scientific admission rules.
admission_requirements: numeric raw hashes and explicit licence
wavelength medium vacuum or documented air conversion
independent physical/family/session/material-assay IDs against all previously seen materials
per-element certified total FeOT/MgO upper <= 0.1 wt% with source hash and sample lot/preparation link
positive support and coverage sufficient for each tested element
instrument-matched development and frozen profile before first final intensity read

purity_route.rule: Independently certified lower purity bound for actual material permits conservative total impurity upper=100-purity_lower. Individual element≤total impurities, then convert elemental mass to FeOT/MgO. Include preparation/matrix additions.

catalog_scope.interpretation: Bounded current catalog check, not a claim of worldwide absence.
catalog_scope.DataCite_targeted_blank_copper_purity_se: 43 metadata results, includes unrelated lithium-ion battery false matches.

priority_followup: C14500 paper/repository: secure independent lot CoA supporting exhaustive Fe/Mg upper bounds, exact physical/session/optimization mapping and air/vac calibration; then build matched development profile with Fe/Mg positive controls before final.
CSA KD2: retrieve actuallot CoA with Fe/Mg upper bounds, preparation and spectrometer axis record; independent lot/session audit and matched development required.
Certified purity powders: possible chemistry route, butexisting 400–410 nm measurement does not enable a Mg test; needs fresh broad-range measurement campaign.
